resources.string: Backup and restore

Back up Ploi profiles (including their tokens), theme and language into a file encrypted with a passphrase separate from your app PIN. Import never replaces existing profiles. PIN, biometrics, launcher widgets and caches are not transferred.
Export
Import
Allow exporting every profile’s token into an encrypted archive? Keep both the passphrase and file safe.
Allow importing Ploi profiles from an encrypted file? Existing profiles will not be overwritten, but theme and language will be restored from the archive.
